text:
Maria (CS): async standup — FinBank renewal in 5 business days. Quick updates:
What I did: ran adoption report, pinged FinBank about SSO failures and shared log export request.
Blockers: recurring 503s around last week drove down usage; customer asking for SLA clarity before renewal call.
Today: need eng to pull logs for 2026-03-10 14:00-15:00 UTC (requesting by EOD) so I can prepare the account brief.

Ajay (Eng): Ack — I'll pull logs and check deploy history. @Sam R. can you look for infra anomalies in that window?

Sam R. (SRE): On it. I see a retry loop from FinBank IP at ~14:05. Creating an incident now and starting debug.

escalation-bot: Alert: High error rate observed for customer finbank-prod between 2026-03-10T14:03Z-14:12Z — 15% 5xx. Incident created: INC-20260310-1.

Ajay (Eng): Found suspicious routing change (commit abc1234) that increases tail latency when prefix cache misses occur. Preparing a revert PR.

Maria (CS): Can we get an ETA for a rollback? I need something to tell the customer before the renewal call.

Sam R. (SRE): If revert approved and CI green, we can roll the change back and promote within ~30m. Need a quick code review + canary signoff.

Kevin S. (SE): Reviewing now. I requested temporary access to FinBank workspace to repro. Also sending them a short client checklist for timeouts. Happy to join a quick call at 10:30 PT.

Ajay (Eng): PR: https://github.com/redwood/serve/pull/4492 — small revert. cc @Sam R. for canary metrics.

Sam R. (SRE): Canary started on ded-1. Metrics looking good; error rate dropping toward baseline. Will promote in 15m if stable.

Maria (CS): Thanks — I'll tell FinBank we expect a rollback window within the hour and offer to follow up on SLA review.

Ajay (Eng): For the logs I needed earlier, Maria, you can run:
```bash
gsutil cp gs://redwood-logs/finbank/2026-03-10/finbank.log.gz .
gzcat finbank.log.gz | grep "ERROR" -n | sed -n '1,200p'
```

Maria (CS): Copying that command into the request to the customer. Will update the thread after the promote. :raised_hands:

Sam R. (SRE): Promote complete. Post-promote metrics stable; INC-20260310-1 marked mitigated.

Maria (CS): Excellent — I'll update the renewal brief and the account team. Thanks everyone.

Kevin S. (SE): Good catch. Glad we had the revert on standby.

Ajay (Eng): Thanks team. Follow-up: I'll add a short test to prevent this routing regression from slipping through.
